title: I Want to Kill My Boss
description:
S01 E01 — Top Gunned
Marana Aerospace Solutions in Arizona is as hot and wild as the surrounding desert. When someone guns down one of the bosses, suspicion falls on the employees. Who hated the boss enough to kill him?

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S03 E05 — Carpool Predator
Mystery shrouds a San Diego exotic wildlife park when one of its valued employees goes missing; as the search for Denise Vasseur intensifies, investigators fear that the most dangerous predator at the park may not be an animal.

title: A Killer Among Friends

A teenager agrees to fix his friend's computer, then vanishes.

title: Murder Loves Company
description:
S01 E05 — Killer Coverup
After a friend and coworker goes missing on a desolate mountain, detectives must sort through a list of tight-knit colleagues with potential motives for murder; one of them has crucial information that will lead to a killer among them.

title: Murder Loves Company
description:
S01 E01 — Dorm Living Nightmare
A girls' movie night leads to a not-so-happy ending for a group of college roommates; police investigate a murder that leads them halfway across the state in search of the killer.

title: Murder Loves Company
description:
S01 E04 — Friends to the End
Close-knit coworkers are devastated when one of their own is found dead near a soccer field at the edge of their quiet Indiana town; investigators ask whether this murder was a random act of violence.

title: Murder Loves Company
description:
S01 E06 — Devil in the Dance Hall
In Texarkana, Ark., a murder within a square dancing community leads investigators through a gauntlet of suspects with alibis and potential motives, including love, jealousy and money.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E04 — Stranger Than Fiction
Police question suspects in the inner circle of Jackie Galloway, a woman found strangled and bound with ritualistic knots; a chance encounter with a prowler leads them to the shocking discovery of a budding serial killer.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E06 — Hollywood Horror Story
Hikers discover the severed head of Hervey Medellín in the Hollywood Hills; the suspects include former lovers, drug cartel hit men and a porn star in this tale of lust, greed and butchery.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

A terrified young escort calls 911 as she flees into the night and vanishes; her family pressures police to take up the search, and investigators uncover a strange cast of characters - plus 10 other bodies spread along a remote stretch of beach.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S07 E14 — Long Island Serial Killer: Caught
When police discover 10 bodies strewn along a remote beach, there are few answers and even fewer suspects; over a decade later, a new investigation uncovers old leads, and police finally think they've found their man.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S02 E03 — Scripting a Murder
Comedian Jim Jefferies recounts his experiences with an intern who seems to have it all - luxury cars, exotic vacations and beautiful women; in May 2016, it all comes crashing down.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S02 E06 — Day in Court
A sheriff's deputy turned actor reaches new heights of fame as a bailiff on an Emmy-winning show. When a shooting at his house leaves him injured and his wife dead, police learn there's more to this court TV star.

title: Death by Fame
description:
S02 E02 — Legal Diva
A bodybuilding attorney lands her own reality series featuring her former fashion model boyfriend; a year later, investigators use her show to map how this legal diva went from the spotlight to becoming a stabbing victim.

title: Death by Fame

After James Brown died on Christmas 2006, some suspect murder; the conspiracy grows with the shooting death of his son-in-law Darren Lumar in November 2008; when detectives dig into Lumar's past, the possibility for motives becomes endless.

title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders

Online astrologer, healer and witch Danielle is a rising mystic influencer; when critics emerge and a man falls for her charm, their magic takes a darker turn, with curses flying and those closest to her caught in the firing line.

YouTuber Randy Stair wants to be the master of his universe, but he struggles to make friends in real life; when the lines begin to blur between his supermarket day job and his online fantasies, he looks for control wherever he can find it.

title: Blood Relatives

title: Signs of a Psychopath

title: Signs of a Psychopath

Detectives find a woman partially clothed and strangled to death in a wooded ditch in Florida; with no leads or suspects, her case goes cold; a surprise confession almost ten years later exposes a deviant sexual psychopath with a murderous fantasy.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E08 — I Wanted To Keep Her
When a grandmother vanishes, her grandson spins a twisted narrative about her demise and the disturbing location of her body inside a freezer; it doesn't take long for detectives to uncover the killer responsible, a parasitic psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E11 — Something Took Control of Me
When a psychopathic husband kills his young wife and leaves her decapitated head in a bathtub, detectives question him about the crime; they realize they are confronting a malingering psychopath with control issues.

A CEO at just 29, Jenea Harvison supports her husband as his dreams of becoming a football player falter; living in his wife's shadow soon proves too much for Roy Harvison, and the price will be more than one life.

A small-town marriage ends in tragedy when a man who uses a wheelchair discovers his loving wife of 10 years wants to end their marriage; a jury must determine if he acted in self-defense or murder.

In Amherst, N.Y., a missing college student's body is found hidden in the woods near a bike path, making the townspeople realize that the predator who has been stalking women for years has escalated from rapist to killer.

description:
S20 E28 — Death by Eyedrops
Jessy Kurczewski calls police to report that she found Lynn Hernan dead in her recliner; the toxicology report shows a toxic ingredient in Lynn's blood and the authorities take a closer look at Jessy.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E01 — The Murders
Paul Bernardo and Karla Homolka embark on a passionate love affair; then, missing schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French turn up dead, and a battered and bruised Homolka tells police Bernardo is the murderer.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E02 — The Tapes
Karla Homolka tells the police that her husband, Bernardo, recorded videos of his assaults on schoolgirls Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; police are unable to find the tapes despite an exhaustive search.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E03 — The Deal
Paul Bernardo's lawyers find the videotapes of the assaults on Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French; the tapes reveal Homolka is complicit in the crimes; unaware of this new information, prosecutors make a controversial deal with Homolka.

title: Ken and Barbie Killers: The Lost Murder Tapes
description:
S01 E04 — The Trial
Paul Bernardo is convicted of the murders of Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French and sentenced to life in prison; Homolka is released after serving just 12 years for her part in the crimes; today, she walks around as a free citizen.

title: The Green River Killer: Mind of a Monster
description: Victims of "The Green River Killer" are still being found; with access to hundreds of hours of unseen police footage, the shocking truth behind one of America's most prolific serial killers is revealed.

title: The Co-Ed Killer: Mind of a Monster
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
Ed Kemper appears to be a gentle giant who offers rides to young female hitchhikers, but behind his charming smile lurks a perverted monster; recorded audio confessions reveal the dark fantasies behind one of America's most notorious serial killers.
